description: SSAO-GTAO-LITE-MVP-1 screen-space ambient occlusion capture variants. MC2_SSAO is the gate (default-OFF); MC2_SSAO_DEBUG overwrites the scene with the raw grayscale AO buffer for inspection. Half-res world-space hemisphere AO that reuses the scene depth + GBuffer1 normals. Definitions only — no captures run here.

entries.description: No SSAO env. Gate OFF -> byte-identical baseline (no AO pass).
SSAO enabled (MC2_SSAO=1). AO multiplied into scene color; look for contact darkening in crevices / under props.
Raw AO buffer view (MC2_SSAO_DEBUG=1): scene overwritten with grayscale occlusion (white=unoccluded, dark=occluded). Diagnostic-only.
